QuestInfo.name: Dark Assassin
QuestInfo.0: You can talk to Avenger's soul once you obtain his relic.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate monsters around your level to find Avenger's lost arrows. Collect 30 of them to receive his belt.
QuestInfo.2: You found Avenger's arrows and received his belt.

0.0: You got my belt! I am Avenger, the sniper of the Dark Lords of Darkness. You have any idea how hard it is to land shots in the dark? REAL hard.
0.1: Collect the dark arrows that I left in the dark creatures I fought.
0.2: Hunt monsters around your level and collect 30 arrows, and then I will release the dark powers of my belt for you.

yes.0: You will be remembered as the assassin of darkness, should you succeed.

no.0: Do you really think this is the end? There is always more, and it is always dark.
